problem: I need to design an event-driven architecture for an e-commerce platform.
goals: I need to design an event-driven architecture for an e-commerce platform.
I want you to propose the event architecture
and give me a before/after comparison showing how the async flow handles the flash sale scenario.
Also show failure handling — what happens when a downstream service is down.
context_facts: We currently process orders synchronously which causes timeouts during peak sales.
The system handles about 10K orders per hour normally but spikes to 100K during flash sales.
